spans.text: The battle with Judge continues.
What...power... We can't even scratch her... She's on a completely different level from the other Sangvis Dolls we've faced before!
The Commander's echelons have eliminated the Sangvis troops. We can buy some time for the cavalry to arrive...
I'll admit that you're not completely worthless to be able to put up such an attack with just the two of you.
I will ask for the last time before I decide to annihilate you. Where is the Doll named M4A1?
About that...
I think she's fixing her makeup in the outpost behind me. Ladies need to take their time, you know? Why don't you wait a little while longer?
Or perhaps you could discard your weapon to show your sincerity. Who knows, M4 might even brew some tea for you!
...So M4A1 is not with you.
...And how are you so sure?
I do not need your assistance, Dreamer. I'll express my gratitude, however, for providing me with information.
Goodness... And here I thought that she must've been in command for you two Dolls to so brazenly trespass into our territory.
...It seems like I came for nothing.
Hey! Are you chickening out?
What? Do you think you are a match against me? I would tear your big mouth apart right now if the Mastermind hadn't prohibited me from unleashing my power on you.
Where's M16? Tell me now!
That decrepit model? Wasn't she taken away by Dreamer?
Dreamer? Where is she?!
How would I know? I've always hated her guts.
However, I'd advise you against provoking her. She's not someone whom you half-baked T-Dolls would be able to go up against.
Treasure your own lives, and think of it as for M4A1's sake. My Master would also be very happy.
You still haven't answered my question yet! Don't you dare leave!
...Judge leaves with her jet propulsion system.
Damn it, she's fast! (Cough cough) SOP II?!
Get back here!
Don't go chasing her by yourself, SOP II! At least wait until the Commander's forces get here...
Damn it! She's not listening at all! I need to follow her!
